answer_1.quote: All of the evaluation tasks in the Sup-NatInst dataset fall into one of the following 12 categories: ... Question Rewriting (QR), Title Generation (TG), Data to Text (DT), and Grammar Error Correction (GEC).
answer_1.outputs: Text outputs for tasks including title generation, data-to-text conversion, grammar correction, and question rewriting.

answer_2.quote: All metrics are measured with the Rouge-L score, which quantifies the sentence-level structural similarity; thus, a high Rouge-L score corresponds to improved performance of a language model.
